roles: FIT and validation only; no outer-test loader, prediction, evaluation or outcome-based selection
representation_cache: private only; original normalized 36-D four-view window tensor, relative window centers, window/seizure/seizure-channel masks, b0_encoder output, temporal_encoder output, seizure_aggregator output, pre-classifier contextual input and frozen A1 logits; exact-logit replay required

probe_training.loss: mean across patients of EZ-weight-2/NEZ-weight-1 BCE normalized within patient
probe_training.head: Linear(input,32)-GELU-Dropout(0.1)-Linear(32,1), zero-initialized final layer; delta=0.5*tanh(raw)
probe_training.seed_rule: 42+fold*1000+base_epoch*10+audit_index; matched variants reset identical torch RNG

audit_A.slope: least-squares coefficient against normalized valid-window index in [0,1], zero when n=1
audit_A.total_variation: mean absolute adjacent difference, zero when n=1
audit_A.across_seizures: mean of per-seizure summary for each channel; no persistence features
audit_A.projection: FIT-only PCA, minimum components reaching >=95% cumulative explained variance, capped at 32 and rank; no labels
audit_A.shuffling: deterministic SHA256-derived permutation per seed/fold/base epoch/patient/seizure/channel, valid windows only; no labels

audit_B.standardization: pooled valid FIT patient/seizure/window/channel values, per-feature mean and population std + 1e-6; frozen on validation
audit_B.slope_variation: same normalized-position slope and mean absolute adjacent difference as A
audit_B.magnitude_control: same 10 summary slots on scalar magnitude; top20/top10 crossing uses pooled FIT-only 80th/90th magnitude quantile, without within-window rank

audit_C.source: same per-seizure recruitment percentile features as B2
audit_C.C1: mean+population-std of 10 per-seizure features, then 10 fixed zero columns
audit_C.C2: same first 20 columns plus 10 persistence features
audit_C.matched_subset: validation patients with >=2 seizures; diagnostic only

variants.D3: zero normalized ABS and RATIO columns

audit_D.architecture: exact A1 full 36-D model and parameter count
audit_D.training: exact A1 30-epoch patient-equal weighted BCE, AdamW lr=1e-4 weight_decay=1e-3, batch=2, epoch seed=42*100000+fold*1000+epoch; no early stopping

audit_E.case_types: pooled median ranking and pooled median Macro-F1: rank below median and F1 below median=BOTH; rank below median only=RANK; F1 below median only=DECISION; otherwise=NEITHER
audit_E.ranking_score: mean of within-cohort percentile ranks of EZ-AUPRC, EZ-AUROC and EZ-MRR

public_policy: aggregate code, lock, reports and compact CSV/JSON only; no patient/channel IDs, tensors, logits, labels, checkpoints, private paths or per-patient table
